title: Velocity Ultra
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#493, 2026-10-15), Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.16, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal environment, DXVK async on, AVX advertised, Metal HUD, recipes steam, controller-sdl, corefonts, dotnet48, vcrun2022, bloody-spell and xact, rated 2 of 5: the pre-launcher shows, the main window opens about one time in twenty, and the ship then moves very slowly. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Launches, not playable. The game's pre-launcher (settings.exe, 32-bit) shows, and Play rarely brings the main window. The launch log has DXVK's 'Failed to create surface' twice and a stack overflow in settings.exe. A Direct3D 9 game, so in the D3DMetal and DXMT modes it goes through DXVK's Direct3D 9 on the default engine; Wine's own Direct3D for this game (the game's own graphics mode on its page) is untested and the natural next try. ProtonDB has it working with GE-Proton on Linux.

knownIssues.symptom: The main window rarely opens after the pre-launcher's Play, and when it does the ship moves very slowly
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed; the log shows DXVK failing to create its presentation surface and a stack overflow in the pre-launcher
knownIssues.fix: none known. Untested: the game's own graphics mode set to Wine's own Direct3D
